lines.text: What? You got something to say to me?
The only way the Ark can continue to function, is under the Central Government's protection. Don't forget that.
If you're not here to help me with some of this work, then I can do without the remarks on my appearance.

Listen Newbie, if any of the top brass set their sights on you, it will be a real headache for us, 
so look after yourself.
I'll listen to anything you have to say.

Don't do my work for me like last time,
just take care of yourself.
What are you doing? Quit dawdling and get moving!

What's troubling you? You can tell me.
I can't help you if you don't tell me anything.
Get rid of those Nikkes who are causing a scene in the Courthouse.
They call this a Courthouse?
The weather here is so nice... It's making me sleepy...
Looks like things just got a whole lot more complicated.
I appreciate your support, but I assume it comes at a price?
I'll do everything I can to show that your trust in me isn't misplaced.
You must have gone through a lot to upgrade me to this level.
Is it for me? Why?
Thanks... Agh, I'm not used to saying things like this.
Just for the record, nothing's changed just because you've given me this.
No funny business while I'm around. It'll only distract me.
Gah, why do you make me so worried all the time?! So annoying!

I hate owing other people favors.
Be it out of kindness or any other emotion, if you did something for me, I guarantee that I will repay you in kind.
Ready to go?
What is it?
Understood.
Entering the battle.
Don't worry. We've got this.
You'll be the commander, Newbie.
Battle start.
This is taking longer than I expected.
How are you holding up, Newbie?
Let me reload and I'll be right there.
Newbie!
I've got a lot on my plate right now. Get the hell out of my way!
I refuse to work overtime! Be gone!
Target down.
Where's the next target?
Feels nice to blow off some steam.
Hmph.
Damn it.
Ow!
Damn... Sorry about that, Newbie.
Mission clear. Good job.
